facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/aria_.interpolate_aria_pose: interpolate a PoseSE3 from a closed-loop trajectory at a given capture timestamp in nanoseconds

facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/aria_.read_frames_from_metadata: read a transforms.json metadata file and return a list of AriaFrame dataclass objects
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/aria_.storePly: store a point cloud with xyz coordinates and rgb colors to a PLY file on disk
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/aria_.project: project 3D world points into 2D image coordinates using a camera pose and intrinsic matrix

facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/extra.run_extract_aria_vrs: run the CLI to extract Aria VRS data with MPS output into JSON format with rectified images
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/extra.run_to_aria_image_frame: run to_aria_image_frame to convert VRS sensor data into AriaImageFrame objects with interpolated poses
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/extra.run_to_frame_json: run to_frame_json to transform an AriaImageFrame into a JSON dictionary with camera intrinsics and poses
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/extra.run_visualize_frames: run visualize_frames to open a Rerun viewer showing 3D point clouds and camera frames over time
facebookresearch_4dgt/tlod/scripts/extra.run_run_single_sequence: run run_single_sequence to process a single VRS recording end to end including rectification and JSON export
